messages:
sec-bot: ALERT — Edge WAF detected reflection/amplification pattern. UDP dst ports clustered on 3478/19302, high packet amplification ratio, 95% of proxy egress capacity hit. auto-severity: P1.
jamal: seeing sustained ~14k pps to edge-proxy-3, backend ok but proxy CPU and egress saturated. no origin errors yet.
maria: looks like STUN/VoIP reflection. src ASN spikes from multiple /24s within ASN 39523. preparing AS-rate-limit and nullroute for top offenders.
alex: starting mitigation — pushing temporary WAF rule to drop UDP dst 3478 with STUN magic. patching edge routing to drop malformed UDP flows.
alex: WAF snippet I pushed: ```
rule_id: wf-8234
if udp.dst_port == 3478 && payload contains "STUN" then action: block
log: true
```
product-support: any customer impact? we got 3 tickets about slow chats and 502s from a single region. prepping comms if customers see errors.
jamal: minimal 502s; most traffic is hit at edge so origin is fine. still seeing client-side timeouts for streaming connections in eu-west. marking impacted region eu-west-1.
taylor: good catch. can we do quick ASN-level rate-limit so we don't overblock legit traffic? prefer token-bucket with burst cap.
maria: applying per-AS token bucket: ASN 39523 -> 1k rps burst 2k, drop after. also nullrouting top 10 offending /24s.
nina: feeding detections into SIEM and correlating with Honeytokens. creating alert rule to flag reflection patterns (udp amplification ratio > 10 && dst_port in [3478,19302]).
sec-bot: wf-8234 triggered 45k times in 12m, mitigated peak at 1824568005. telemetry: proxy egress reduced to normal within 60s of rule deployment.
jamal: confirming: mitigation stabilized traffic at 1824568070. continuing monitoring. will keep AS-rate-limit for another 2 hours then step down.
product-support: drafting customer note: short outage in eu-west impacting streaming/chat. ETA for full removal depends on traffic baseline. ping me draft and I'll send.
taylor: post-incident items: 1) tune WAF signatures for STUN/UDP reflection, 2) add auto-asn-blackhole playbook, 3) check RBAC audit for who can push edge routes/rules, 4) validate audit logs/keys for any config pushes during window.
maria: on RBAC: no config changes by humans aside from my push; sec-bot and jamal confirm. we'll attach CI/CD audit entries.
jamal: opening incident ticket and assigning postmortem ownership to jamal. writing timeline.
nina: KMS rotation? nothing compromised — this was network-level, no key exposure. we should still add a note to review ephemeral keys and cloud IAM calls during timeframe.
taylor: agree — add an audit task: pull CloudTrail/KMS access logs for 30m before/after 1824567890.
sec-bot: creating follow-ups: wf-8234 -> permanent signature PR, auto-asn-blackhole runbook, SIEM tuning, customer notice template.
product-support: :thumbsup: will update customers once we confirm low risk and final timing.
jamal: closing active mitigation in 30m if stable. will post full timeline and RCA in #postmortems. thanks for quick responses everyone.
